Pierce Clark is an engineering student at Harvey Mudd College who builds and verifies digital hardware. He's designed a pipelined RISC-V processor in SystemVerilog, written certification tests for the RISC-V Sdtrig debug extension as a Clay-Wolkin Research Fellow, and worked on space-qualified networking hardware at TRL11.
